name: A dungeon entered on foot keeps its authored creatures and loot; a Dungeon Finder group scales (#11184)
contract: Issue #11184: on Ascension a classic five-player dungeon scales only for a Random Dungeon Finder run; walking
in keeps the authored creature levels, whatever the Destiny Weaver switch says, and the loot keeps its authored
stats. Maraudon (map 349) is finder entry 26 with the band 20-59. A level-30 character who walked in with their
open world switch on sees a level-45 Black Riding Wolf 5194 at 45 and is sent 45, and loots War Master Voone's
9237 Flightblade Throwing Axe 28972 at its authored required level 55. Once their group is a Dungeon Finder
group assigned Maraudon, the same character sees and is sent the wolf at their own level 30, and turning the
open world switch off leaves that view in place.

steps.label: CONTROL: the walker's open world switch is on
Walking in, the wolf keeps its authored level 45
Walking in, the client is sent the authored level 45
The corpse holds the authored Flightblade Throwing Axe
Walking in, the axe keeps its authored required level 55
The group becomes a Dungeon Finder group assigned Maraudon
In a Dungeon Finder group the wolf stands at the walker's level 30
In a Dungeon Finder group the client is sent level 30
The open world switch off leaves the Dungeon Finder view in place
